nodes.title: gati and chhaano 'quiz in costume' fixes (the lead's review): the skill is the mechanic. gati prakaar shows no thing or name before Check at any look (the trail is the evidence); gati sandarbh has three reference cards at every look (a blind guess right 1 in 6, not 1 in 4) and look 1 uses only the kit's own scenes (the lamp post became the kit's signboard); gati aage refuses the flag until both movers are chalked for the SAME time by the child (the clock no longer drops marks itself; a mover whose trip is over takes no mark); gati nikaalo and badlo draw the law's ghost (typed speed, same time) landing on or away from the real mark, the track grown to hold it (never clipped); chhaano sukha winnowing starts with a first throw (one handful, no sack) before Near / Far is accepted. Mal-rules unchanged and still mapped (farther-faster = ch08-t02 m1 after same-time marks; heavy-far = ch09-t01 m2 after the throw). Reverse: a child pilot shows the marks or the throw become a rote extra tap (both placed and ignored, verdicts unchanged).

After the fixes: play-cert (forge3-qa, p360/p412/l1366) gati 56/56 and chhaano 40/40 samples pass at every size (table 4168/4168, other families' samples unchanged); real taps at 360 x 640 (page.mouse on audit targets, play-ctl test ids, never dispatch): 24 gati runs (sandarbh, prakaar, aage, nikaalo, badlo on seeds 3, 17, 8 plus mal and refusal states) and 14 chhaano sukha runs (farak, kram, the throw, every sukha mal-rule), all as expected, taps' acts equal to the law's; smallest target 44 x 44 (aage flag button, counter wheel halves).
